_README: Single source of truth for the FCC Broadband Consumer Labels.
Run `node internal/build-fcc-labels.mjs` to regenerate BOTH the paste-ready
label markup and the machine-readable CSV from this file, so the two can
Anything still null is genuinely unknown and must come from Jermaine.
Everything else was derived from documents Wifi Squared has already
published; the source is named in _derivedFrom so it can be re-checked.
Re-verify the label format against 47 CFR Part 8 and the FCC's current
Broadband Consumer Label order before publishing. The rules have been
amended more than once and the data dictionary for the CSV may have moved.
_frn_note: NEEDED. 10-digit FCC Registration Number from apps.fcc.gov/cores. The Unique Plan Identifier is 'F' + FRN + the plan code, so no label can be finalized without it.
_networkManagement_note: NEEDED. The label must link to an Open Internet / network management disclosure. A draft built from Wifi Squared's own Terms section 6 is at internal/network-management-DRAFT.html — publish it as network-management.html after Jermaine confirms it, then set this to https://wifisquared.com/network-management.html

shared._introductoryRate_derivedFrom: Master Revision Brief section 9: 'without annual contracts or temporary promotional pricing'
shared._contractRequired_derivedFrom: Terms section 2, 'No Contracts — Service is month-to-month'
shared._providerMonthlyFees_derivedFrom: No recurring provider fee appears anywhere in Terms section 2; equipment is covered by the one-time fee
shared._oneTimeFee_derivedFrom: Pricing section disclosure and Terms section 2; refundable if equipment is returned in working condition within 30 days of installation
shared._earlyTerminationFee_derivedFrom: Terms section 4, 'You can cancel service anytime', with month-to-month billing and no contract. CONFIRM with Jermaine that no cancellation charge exists in practice.
shared._governmentTaxes_derivedFrom: Pricing disclosure: 'Applicable sales tax is added to this fee and to any mesh Wi-Fi units purchased'
shared._discountsBundles_derivedFrom: Terms section 2, 'Annual Plans — Annual pre-payments receive a discount.' This CONTRADICTS the earlier label draft, which assumed no discounts existed.
shared._data_derivedFrom: Every plan card lists 'No data caps'; Mobile Connect lists 'Unlimited data'. Note Terms section 6 permits throttling for sustained excessive use — that is a network management practice, not an additional-data charge, and belongs in the network management disclosure.

_typicalSpeeds_note: NEEDED, per plan: typical download Mbps, typical upload Mbps, typical latency ms.
These are TYPICAL observed performance, not the 'up to' advertised rate, and the
advertised rate is carried above only so the two can be sanity-checked against
each other. Jermaine should pull them from real customer measurements during a
busy period, not from the plan's ceiling.
